name: carousel-3d

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows four evenly spaced cards on the ring, all fully in frame and clearly angled.

tagline: A ring of photo cards rotates in 3D and follows a drag.
summary: A draggable carousel that places image cards around an invisible circle in 3D space, tilts the ring and turns it slowly. Dragging spins it; releasing resumes the auto-spin.
appearance: Rectangular photo cards stand around an unseen circle on a black stage, each tilted and angled like a ring seen from slightly above. Cards near the middle face forward while edge cards turn away in perspective.
behaviour: The whole ring turns slowly on its own. Pressing and dragging left or right spins it faster in that direction, and letting go restarts the steady rotation.
demo_content: Mountain and landscape photos on the cards; heading Drag to rotate.
use_when: A portfolio or gallery wants to show many images as a browsable carousel with depth.
avoid_when: It pulls in Three.js and sizes cards in fixed pixels, so the ring crowds or clips on narrow screens.
customise: items (image URLs), width, height, className and containerClassName are props; the ring radius and rotation speed are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A Three.js CSS3D render plus a continuous motion animation every frame.

a11y.note: Rotation is drag-only and endless, images have no alt text, and reduced-motion is not honoured.

issues: Cards use fixed pixel sizes, so the ring can overflow a narrow container.
Images are painted as CSS backgrounds with no alt text.
polish_why: Convincing depth and smooth spin; images lack alt text and the ring can overflow.
